newsitem.title: USA: El Paso, MCN propose Delmarva LNG.
newsitem.headline: El Paso, MCN propose Delmarva LNG.

text.p: Tennessee Gas Pipeline Co said Wednesday it plans to form a joint venture with MCN Investment Corp to build a liquefied natural gas facility on the Delmarva Peninsula, near Delaware's border with Maryland.
The proposed $40 to $50 million project would provide liquefaction, storage and vaporization services beginning in early 2000, according to Tennessee Gas.
The El Paso Energy Corp subsidiary said it and the MCN Energy Group Inc subsidiary would equally onw the venture, Continental States Peaking Services LLC.

"Depending on the level of interest shown by potential customers in our open season, this facility could provide between ome and two billion cubic feet equivalent of natural gas storage service, which equates to peak-day withdrawal capacity of 100 to 200 million cubic feet per day of revaporized natural gas," MCN Investment chief executive Rai Bhargava said.

The planned facility would be directly connected to the Eastern Shore Natural Gas pipeline system, with access to the Williams Cos Inc's Transcontinental Gas Pipe Line and Columbia Gas Transmission systems.
Several Northeast satellite LNG storage facilities also could be supplied by this facility, MCN spokesman Stewart Lawrence said.
"Pipeline capacity into this region is severely constrained during the peak winter months, but generally available in the warmer months, noted John Somerhalder, president of Tennessee Gas Pipeline.
"The Continental States facility will allow customers to store lower-cost gas in the market area and have it ready for reliable delivery when it's needed most."
Open season for the joint project begins at 0800 EDT/1200 GMT June 18 and ends 1700 EDT/2100 GMT July 25.
The project's size, capacity and feasibility will be based on the open season results, Tennessee Gas pointed out.
Following the completion of a successful open season, Continental States plans to file for Federal Energy Regulatory Commission approval of the project.
